findings.claim: The primary username/password login crashes after a successful 2xx: staffPasswordLogin() awaits enterStaffPanel(), which is not defined anywhere in the repository (only enterPanel() exists). The button stays on 'در حال بررسی...'; the token is already in localStorage so a manual reload enters the panel. Every e2e spec clicks 'ورود با پیامک' first, so the path is never exercised.
findings.evidence: apps/business/js/staff-system.js:L468,L471,L472 (calls) vs L556 (function enterPanel); grep -rn enterStaffPanel -> only those 3 lines + standalone/business.html:L7952-7956; e2e/tests/panel-authed-audit.spec.ts:L45, panels-batch18-regression.spec.ts:L79 (OTP path only)

findings.claim: On the reservations tab every row action (رسید/نشاند/نیومد/وضعیت/لغو/تاریخچه) passes the row index of the freshly fetched `source` array, but the handlers read RES[i]; RES only ever holds the dashboard's 'today' fetch. On the فردا/آینده/گذشته/همه tabs (or whenever ordering differs) a different reservation is mutated; when RES is still the demo array a row without `code` shows a success toast with no request at all.
findings.evidence: apps/business/js/reservations.js:L54-58,L65,L162-168,L179,L200,L205; apps/business/js/data.js:L42,L56,L661 (only RES assignment); data.js:L100-103 (toast without request)

findings.claim: 'رزرو جدید' sends restaurant_id = STAFF_INFO?.restaurant_id. STAFF_INFO is only set by the OTP path and is null after any page reload (session restore) or password login; the API requires restaurant_id as a UUID -> 422. After a branch switch it is the login-time branch -> 403 'رزرو فقط برایِ شعبه‌ی فعالِ خودت'.

The offline Outbox entry for a manual reservation uses restaurant_id:'self', date:'today|tomorrow|upcoming' and a Persian-digit time; the schema requires zUuid/zDateStr/zTimeStr, so the queued op is rejected on every sync while the toast promised it would sync.

changeStatus() calls renderResList() (which re-fetches from the server) before the PATCH is sent and does not re-render after success; the list shows the pre-change status next to a success toast until the user navigates.

loadWaitlist sets _wlLoaded=true regardless of fetch result; after a 403/500/timeout the 'نمونه' note is hidden and WL_DEMO_QUEUE (سارا محمدی, علی رضایی, مریم کریمی) plus WL_DEMO_ANALYTICS (142/69%/22 دق) render as the restaurant's real queue on the waitlist page and the dashboard. The analytics endpoint needs canViewAnalytics while the view is gated by canManageWaitlist, so a waitlist-only employee always sees the fake analytics.

loadStaff sets _staffLoaded=true even on failure, so STAFF_DEMO (ids demo1/demo2, ۰۹۱۲۰۰۰۰۰۰۱) renders as the real team without the 'نمونه' note; the permission editor then PATCHes with a fake staff_id.

loadTables installs DEMO_TABLES (ids 'demo-t1'…'demo-t10') and marks _tablesLoaded=true on any failure; the floor plan, occupancy KPI and the walk-in table picker then present 10 fake tables as real, and every write (rename/state/QR/delete/walk-in table_id) hits the server with a fake id.

'درآمد امروز' and 'میانگین خرید هر نفر' are computed from constants (850,000 × party × 1.8 VIP × 1.25 preorder) with REVENUE_CONFIG.connected hard-coded false; they are labelled 'تخمین'/≈ but not [DEMO]. The 'اتصال صندوق' button only shows a toast.

When GET /restaurant/pricing fails, rPricing keeps the hard-coded sample suggestions with live 'قبول' buttons; accepting one calls pricingSave -> PUT with the fabricated rule and base_min_spend_toman:0, overwriting the server's real rules.
loadClubMembers returns [] on any non-2xx, so the loyalty page renders '۰ عضو', empty tiers and 'این ماه تولدی نیست' with no error state or retry — 'نمی‌دانیم' reported as 'وجود ندارد'.

loadHours and loadCancellationPolicy have no failure marker: after a failed GET the empty draft / hard-coded default policy render as the current configuration, and 'ذخیره' / 'ارسالِ پیشنهاد' would send those defaults to the server.
There is no logout control anywhere in the panel: staffLogout() has zero call sites, and the refresh token is persisted in localStorage, so a session on a shared front-desk device never ends.
findings.evidence: apps/business/js/staff-system.js:L587-596; apps/business/js/data.js:L135; grep -rn staffLogout apps/business -> definition only; index.html has no logout element

findings.claim: loadMoreReservations() and RES_NEXT_CURSOR exist but nothing calls them; the API pages at 100, so a day with more than 100 reservations is silently truncated in the reservations tab and dashboard.

viewCustomerHistory builds 'سابقه‌ی رزرو' by filtering the in-memory RES (today's list) by display name; guests with real history see 'سابقه‌ای ثبت نشده'. The customers tab already has a real detail endpoint that is not used here.

cbApply's offline branch commits CB locally, clears the dirty banner, locks the button and pushes the notification 'کش‌بک به‌روز شد' without a 2xx and without an Outbox entry; the change is lost on reload while the notification list keeps claiming it was updated. The route also has no audit().

The manual-reservation date dropdown labels are generated from a hard-coded start 'پنجشنبه ۱۵ خرداد' while the submitted date is today+offset; on any other day the shown weekday/date and the success toast label disagree with the stored date.
When the reservations fetch fails for a logged-in user, the tab shows the demo rows (with live action buttons) and a 'نمونه' note instead of an error state with retry.
Staff permission changes (PATCH /restaurant/staff) and cashback percentage changes (PATCH /restaurant/cashback) write without audit(); hours, photos, table-QR and password routes do audit.
findings.evidence: api/src/app/api/v1/restaurant/staff/route.ts and cashback/route.ts: grep -c 'audit(' = 0; hours/route.ts, photos/route.ts, tables/[id]/qr/route.ts, staff/password/route.ts = 1

findings.claim: rAnalytics falls back to the hard-coded sample block (136 رزرو, ۶۶٪, ۲۴۸ مشتری, fixed weekday bars) with a 'داده‌ی نمونه' banner and no retry when the fetch fails.
The 'ریسک نوشو' chip and the high-risk 'تماس' button on tonight's rows can never render: r.noShowTier / r.risk are not produced by mapResRow.
Campaign preview header shows the hard-coded sender 'کافه‌رستوران ویستا'; the 'مشتری جدید' segment count is always '—'; the birthday SMS body is the literal two-word text 'تبریکِ تولد'.
refreshActiveView omits 'chat' and 'menu', so after a branch switch those views keep the previous branch's data.
The offline 'آفر میز' Outbox op carries entry_id but the route ignores the body; on sync promoteNext may offer the table to a different guest than the one named in the toast.
Coupons, automations and accepted pricing rules cannot be deactivated or removed from the UI (only GET/POST routes exist for coupons/automations; pricing PUT replaces but no remove control).

Touch targets below 24–44px: .snote-del has no size (font 20px, padding 0 4px), .notif-clear is a text button with no min-height, .dr-act ≈26px, .gal-del/.s-clear/.t-remove exactly 24px, .btn-sm 34px (< 44px comfortable floor).
Physical left/right properties instead of logical ones in the panel stylesheet and inline styles.

Icon-only × buttons without aria-label, and 14 clickable <div>s without role/tabindex (party-size .opt, .tbl-act state options, .seg-card/.seg-cell, .top-cust, .kpi-card, .notif-item, branch rows, logo pickers).

Ten API client methods have no call site in the panel (branchCreate, createMember, events/addEvent/updateEvent/deleteEvent, assistantStats, chatList/chatMessages/chatSend); routes /restaurant/fraud-signals, /restaurant/reports, POST /restaurant/members and PATCH /restaurant/customers/[userId] are unreached from this panel.
findings.evidence: apps/business/js/data.js:L229-232,L283,L348,L406-409,L434; grep counts in this audit (0 call sites outside data.js)

findings.claim: walkinLookup decides 'مشتری قدیمی' vs 'مهمان جدید' from the in-memory CLUB array, which is only populated by the loyalty tab or a prior walk-in; returning members are usually shown as new (the server still enrols/reuses correctly).
Notification read state is local only; server items arrive unread:false so the unread ping only ever reflects locally pushed events.
handleAiAction falls back to the toast 'این اقدام به‌زودی به‌صورت خودکار قابل‌اجراست' for unknown card ids — a placeholder in the production path.
Error states without a retry control: customer profiles, campaign history, chat inbox.
The mandate describes apps/business/src-v2 as a present React experiment; it was deleted in commit 95e95f1 and is absent from disk, the git index and CI. Docs/mandates referencing it are stale.
findings.evidence: ls apps/business/src-v2 -> No such file; git ls-files apps/business/src-v2 -> 0; git show --stat 95e95f1 -> RestaurantIntelligenceDashboard.jsx 249 deletions

findings.claim: Two routes read a restaurant id from the body: POST /api/v1/reservations (restaurant_id) and PATCH /api/v1/restaurant/staff (restaurant_id as branch assignment). Both validate it against the authenticated tenant/branch (resolveStaffRestaurant equality; tenant-scoped findFirst), so no cross-tenant path was found. Recorded for completeness.
